name: University of Canterbury
summary: Christchurch university with seven faculties, professional forestry, and an accelerated international route into Engineering (Honours).

ib.text: The full IB Diploma must be awarded, with English Language A (SL or HL) or Language B HL, and any maths. The international Engineering (Honours) pathway needs HL 6 in Chemistry, Physics and Maths.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours (international pathway)
programmes.about: An accelerated route for high-achieving international students: pre-university study from July, a term and a summer of foundation courses on campus, then three full years in your chosen engineering discipline.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma awarded with HL 6 or higher in Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics, plus English Language A (SL or HL) or Language B HL.
programmes.selectionNote: The dates on the page are for the 2026 cohort (study from July 2026, three years on campus from 2027); contact UC for the next cohort's dates.

flagshipSource.title: UC Engineering: the first engineering school in New Zealand

programmes.name: Bachelor of Forestry Science
programmes.about: A professional 480-point degree combining core science with management, commerce and technology, with field stations near Arthur's Pass and Westport and 90 days of practical forestry work experience.
programmes.selectionNote: Open to everyone who gains University Entrance; UC recommends IB or equivalent biology and maths including statistics, and may fast-track strong students.

flagshipSource.title: UC Bachelor of Forestry Science: field stations at Arthur's Pass and Westport, most graduates employed before finishing

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: International students can enter Engineering (Honours) on an accelerated pathway with IB HL 6 in Chemistry, Physics and Maths.

notes: UC says the fee estimate on your Offer of Place must normally be prepaid before a student visa can be granted.
No 2027 or 2028 application deadline is published for international applicants; apply well ahead, because you also need a student visa.
Bachelor of Forestry Science can start in Semester 1 or 2 (February or July).
